edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
